description: Spanish provincial plate codes (contraseñas de provincia), union of the official lists: Código de la Circulación 1934 art. 233 (52 codes), Decreto 2046/1971 art. 233 (adds SH, Sahara), and RGV 1999 Anexo XVIII II.A (renames GE→GI in 1992 per RD 567/1992, PM→IB in 1997 per RD 1209/1997, OR→OU in 1999). Per-code validity windows (GE until 1992-06-09, GI from 1992-06-10, PM until 1997-08-05, IB from 1997-08-06, OR until 1999-07-25, OU from 1999-07-26, SH only 1971-c.1976) cannot be expressed here and are not enforced.
